blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We propose LayerScope , a label-free, layerwise framework that aims to characterize a model’s learned representations in video and multimodal settings. Evaluating downstream performance using representations from final or intermediate layers typically requires large amounts of labeled data, repeated task-specific evaluations, and substantial computation. To address these limitations, LayerScope uses local, global, distributional, and correspondence-based geometric metrics to compare layerwise representation structure within and across models without requiring task-specific labels. We evaluate seven architecturally diverse models across video and multimodal classification, clustering, and text-to-video retrieval tasks from MVEB/MVEB+. We find that intermediate-layer representations can outperform final-layer and model-default outputs. We also find that no single geometric metric consistently predicts downstream performance, but note that distinct layerwise geometric signatures emerge across model families. LID shows task-dependent relationships with performance, while RankMe provides the strongest measure for classification and clustering, but is not a universal layer selector. We also find that pairing-aware metrics explain retrieval better than distributional distances alone. LayerScope therefore offers a framework for comparing representations across models and layers, enabling a more systematic evaluation in video and multimodal settings.
blocks.zh: 我们提议建立无标签、分层的框架, 利用最终或中间层的表述来评价下游的业绩,通常需要大量贴标签的数据、重复进行具体任务的评价和大量的计算。 为了克服这些局限性,LayerScope使用本地的,全球的,分布的,和基于函证的几何度量衡来比较模型内部和模型之间的分层表示结构,而不需要特定任务的标签. 我们从MVEB/MVEB+中评估了七种不同建筑的模型,包括视频和多式联运分类、集群和从视频到视频的检索任务。 我们发现,中间层的表示可以超过最终层和模型默认输出. 我们还发现,没有一个单一的几何度量标准一致地预测下游的性能,但注意到,在模系中出现了不同的分层几何特征。 LID显示任务依赖与性能的关系,而RankMe则为分类和集群提供了最强的度量,但不是通用的层选择器. 我们还发现,配对认识的衡量标准比单是分布距离更能解释检索。 因此,LayersScope为比较模型和层次之间的表述提供了一个框架,从而能够在视频和多式联运环境中进行更系统的评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal embedding models are typically evaluated through downstream benchmarks such as MVEB [ 5 ] or MTEB [ 31 ] and their default output representations. These benchmarks measure capability across tasks including classification, clustering, and retrieval, but treat the internal learned representations as a black box. Thus, benchmark scores merely indicate model success or failure, but provide limited insight into how useful representations develop throughout the network. Evaluating intermediate layers can be computationally expensive and task-dependent. Geometric measures provide label-free, task-independent diagnostics of representation structure: the metrics themselves do not depend on downstream labels or task scores, although their relationship with downstream performance may vary across tasks. While geometric measures do not replace benchmark performance, they characterize the intrinsic properties of the learned representations i.e., local, global, distributional and correspondence-sensitive properties that downstream scores do not expose.
blocks.zh: 多式联运嵌入模型一般通过MVEB[5]或MTEB[31]及其默认输出表示等下游基准来评价. 这些基准衡量各种任务的能力,包括分类、集群和检索,但将内部学到的表述视为一个黑匣子。 因此,基准分数只是表明模式的成功或失败,但对整个网络如何发展有用表述提供了有限的见解。 评估中间层在计算上可能很昂贵,并且依赖于任务. 几何度量法为表达结构提供了无标签,任务独立的诊断: 度量法本身并不依赖于下游标签或任务分数,尽管它们与下游性能的关系可能因任务而异. 虽然几何计量不能取代基准性能,但它们是所学表现的内在特性,即下游分数不暴露的地方、全球、分配和通信敏感特性。

blocks.en: In this work, we refer to label-free geometric diagnostics for metrics that do not require downstream labels or task scores, and are primarily computed using a model’s learned representations. We also refer to task-dependent conditions, in cases where a model’s geometric properties changes with downstream performance. Our work aims to investigate beyond whether geometric measures capture representation quality , but to identify the conditions under which geometric metrics may explain, characterize, or predict useful downstream behavior in models.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提到不需要下游标签或任务分数的测量标准无标签几何诊断,并且主要利用模型的学得表示来计算。 我们还提到依赖任务的条件,当模型的几何特性随着下游的性能而变化时。 我们的工作旨在调查几何测量是否掌握了表达质量,但找出几何测量在何种条件下可以解释、描述或预测模型中有用的下游行为。

blocks.en: Internal representations can change substantially across layers in the model, and useful semantic information can emerge before the final layer in a network; this motivates auditing intermediate representations rather than considering only the output of the last layer as the object of evaluation [ 10 ] . This has direct implications across encoder model families and objective functions used during training. Geometric quantities such as local intrinsic dimensionality (LID), effective rank [ 39 ] , and cross-modal distributional distance provide different mathematical approaches to characterize the high dimensional structure of a model’s representations—and in some cases, without requiring task labels. Global and local geometric diagnostics provide complementary views of learned representations. Global measures characterize dataset-level dimensionality or spectral utilization, whereas local measures such as LID characterize neighborhood-level manifold complexity. Prior work such as GRIDS-LID [ 4 ] motivates intrinsic-dimensionality analysis of learned representations for anomaly detection in self-supervised speech models (S3Ms), but it remains unclear whether intrinsic metrics such as LID are reliable diagnostics for the evaluation of different model architectures, layers, modalities, and downstream tasks. In this context, LayerScope asks whether geometric metrics can explain or predict downstream performance by inspection of a model’s representations. Geometry is thus not a replacement for representation quality, but rather a complementary metric to characterize learned representations and capture when geometric diagnostics agree with, or diverge from downstream performance. Positive results establish where geometry is informative; negative results pinpoint to the limits of the diagnostics, e.g., constraints in LID as a single metric when identifying the best-performing layer.
blocks.zh: 内部表述可以在模型的各个层次发生重大变化,有用的语义信息可以在网络的最后一个层次之前出现;这激励着审计中间表述,而不是仅仅考虑最后一个层次的产出作为评价的对象[10]. 这对编码模型家庭和培训中使用的客观功能具有直接影响。 几何量,如本地内在维度(LID)、有效排名[39]和跨模式分布距离,提供了不同的数学方法来描述一个模型的表示式的高维度结构——在某些情况下,不需要任务标签。 全球和地方几何诊断提供了对所学表现的补充观点。 全球措施是数据集层面的维度或光谱利用的特征,而LID等地方措施则是街区层面多重复杂性的特征。 之前的工作如GRIDS-LID[4],激发了对自我监督的语音模型(S3M)中异常检测的所学表现的内在维度分析,但仍不清楚LID等内在度量是否是评价不同模型架构,层,模式,下游任务的可靠诊断. 在这方面,LayerScope询问几何测量标准是否能够通过检查模型的表示来解释或预测下游的性能. 因此,几何学不是代表质量的替代,而是在几何诊断方法同意或偏离下游性能时,用来描述所学表现和捕捉方法的一种补充指标。 积极结果确定了几何信息的信息;消极结果指明了诊断的限度,例如,在确定表现最佳的层时,将LID中的制约作为一个单一的衡量标准。

For classification and clustering, eligible post-block hidden states are mean pooled; model-default outputs are evaluated separately. For models with shared text–video spaces, the model-specific normalization, pooling, and projection operations are applied at every text and video layer, producing the complete pair matrix p = ( ℓ T , ℓ V ) ∈ 𝒫 m , t p=(\ell_{T},\ell_{V})\in\mathcal{P}_{m,t} . blocks.en: We study how the geometry and downstream performance of video and multimodal representations evolve across network depth. To do so, we introduce LayerScope , a layerwise evaluation framework that jointly audits intermediate representations using downstream tasks and complementary local, global, and cross-modal geometric diagnostics. This allows us to address three distinct questions: first , how representation geometry evolves across network depth; second , whether geometric measures are associated with downstream performance; and third , whether those measures can reliably identify high-performing representations.
blocks.zh: 我们研究视频和多式联运的几何和下游表现如何在网络深度上演化。 为此,我们引入了LearsScope,这是一个分层评价框架,利用下游任务和互补的本地、全球和跨模式几何诊断法共同审计中间表述。 这使我们能够处理三个不同的问题:第一,代表几何如何在网络深度演变;第二,几何计量是否与下游业绩相关;第三,这些措施是否能够可靠地确定表现良好的表现。

blocks.en: Using LayerScope , we first ask when intermediate representations outperform final-layer or usual model outputs across classification, clustering, zero-shot classification, and text-to-video retrieval (T2VR). We then examine whether intrinsic geometric metrics track layerwise downstream performance, and whether layer selection using these metrics can identify high-performing representations with low regret. Finally, for multimodal models, we study how text and video representations relate across network depth; this is achieved by distinguishing marginal distributional proximity from pair-sensitive alignment and evaluating how each relates to retrieval behavior. Across predictive, contrastive, and autoregressive model families, we also compare their layerwise geometric profiles, allowing us to understand the evolution of representations in the network and emerging patterns which we refer to as geometric signatures.
blocks.zh: 使用LyerScope,我们首先询问中间表示值何时超越了终端或通常模型输出,跨越分类,集群,零镜头分类,以及文本到视频检索(T2VR). 然后,我们审查内在几何度量衡是否依次跟踪下游的性能,以及利用这些度量衡进行层层选择是否能够发现表现优异且悔恨不大的表示. 最后,对于多式联运模式,我们研究文本和视频表述如何在网络深度之间相互联系;这是通过区分边际分布的接近度和对配对敏感的配对度,以及评估每种配对与检索行为的关系来实现的。 纵观预测性,对比性,以及自递性模型家族,我们也比较了它们的分层几何剖面图,使我们能够了解网络中表达式的演变以及我们称之为几何特征的新兴模式。

blocks.en: LayerScope evaluates models using geometric diagnostics to uncover aspects of representation structure that are not directly observable from benchmark scores alone. Our framework does not propose geometric analyses as alternatives to downstream tasks, but rather, as complementary label-free evaluation proxies. In our work, these support the evaluation of failure modes in a model, as well as layer-selection criteria. Figure 1 summarizes the framework and experimental workflow.
blocks.zh: LayerScope利用几何诊断来评价模型,以发现仅从基准分数中无法直接观察到的表示结构的方面. 我们的框架并未提出几何分析作为下游任务的替代品,而是作为补充性的无标签评价代词。 在我们的工作中,这些支持在模型中评价失败模式以及层选择标准. 图1概述了框架和实验工作流程。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (i) We introduce LayerScope , a layerwise evaluation framework that jointly audits downstream performance and local, global, and cross-modal representation geometry across seven heterogeneous video and multimodal models; (ii) We conduct a systematic layerwise evaluation across classification, clustering, zero-shot classification, and T2VR, and analyze geometry as both a performance correlate and a label-free layer-selection criterion using association and selection regret; and (iii) We distinguish marginal distributional proximity from pair-sensitive alignment, showing when geometric measures track retrieval behavior and when correspondence-aware diagnostics reveal text–video structure that marginal distribution measures cannot capture.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) 我们引入了LearsScope,一个分层评价框架,共同审计下游的业绩以及七种不同视频和多模式模型的本地、全球和跨模式代表几何;(二) 我们进行系统分层评价,跨越分类、集群、零镜头分类和T2VR,并利用关联和选择的遗憾,分析几何既是性能相关标准,也是无标签的层选择标准;(三) 我们区分了边际分布近距离和对等敏感的配对,在几何计量跟踪检索行为和函证诊断显示边际分布措施无法捕捉的文本-video结构时显示。

blocks.en: We introduce LayerScope , a layerwise evaluation framework that jointly audits downstream performance and local, global, and cross-modal representation geometry across seven heterogeneous video and multimodal models;
blocks.zh: 我们引入了LearsScope,这是一个分层评价框架,它联合审计下游的业绩以及地方、全球和跨模式代表几何,涵盖7个不同的视频和多式联运模式;

blocks.en: We conduct a systematic layerwise evaluation across classification, clustering, zero-shot classification, and T2VR, and analyze geometry as both a performance correlate and a label-free layer-selection criterion using association and selection regret; and
blocks.zh: 我们通过分类、分组、零镜头分类和T2VR,进行系统的分层评价,并利用关联和选择遗憾,分析几何作为性能关联和无标签层选择标准;

blocks.en: We distinguish marginal distributional proximity from pair-sensitive alignment, showing when geometric measures track retrieval behavior and when correspondence-aware diagnostics reveal text–video structure that marginal distribution measures cannot capture.
blocks.zh: 我们区分边际分布的接近度与对等敏感的对齐度,显示几何测量跟踪检索行为时,以及函证-认识诊断显示边际分布测量无法捕捉的文本-视频结构时.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Embedding benchmarks have expanded from individual modalities toward broad, task-diverse evaluation suites. MTEB standardized evaluation of text embeddings across multiple downstream tasks [ 31 ] , while MSEB extended this style of evaluation to sound representations [ 18 ] . More recently, MVEB introduced a video embedding benchmark spanning (zero-shot) classification, pair classification, clustering, retrieval, and video-centric question answering—with MVEB+ providing a larger pool of tasks across video, text, and audio [ 5 ] . These benchmarks measure downstream performance, but do not generally examine how learned representations vary within the network, nor do they commonly treat network depth as an evaluation variable i.e., layer number. For example, MVEB evaluates models using its model-default embedding output without layer-specific tuning [ 5 ] . This leaves a few open questions: how does downstream performance vary across layers in a network? Is it possible to identify high-performing internal representations in a model, without exhaustively evaluating every layer on labeled tasks? From this perspective, LayerScope complements downstream benchmarking by treating network-depth (i.e., number of hidden layers) as an evaluation variable, and testing whether label-free layerwise geometric measures can be both descriptive and predictive of downstream behavior.
blocks.zh: 嵌入性基准已从个别模式扩大到广泛、任务分散的评价套件。 MTEB对跨多个下游任务嵌入文本的标准化评价[31],而MSEB则将这种评价风格扩展至健全的表示[18]. 最近,MVEB引入了涵盖(零镜头)分类、对子分类、集群、检索和以视频为中心的问题回答的视频嵌入基准,MVEB+提供了跨越视频、文本和音频的更大任务组合[5]。 这些基准衡量下游的业绩,但一般不检查所学表现如何在网络内发生差异,也不把网络深度作为评价变量,即层数. 例如,MVEB使用它的模型默认嵌入输出来评价模型,而不进行层特定调制[5]. 这留下了一些未解的问题:网络中下游的性能如何各层不同? 是否有可能在一个模型中确定业绩良好的内部表述,而不对标注任务的每一层进行详尽的评估? 从这个角度出发,LayerScope通过将网络深度(即隐藏层的数量)作为评价变量来补充下游基准,并测试无标签的地层测量是否既能描述下游行为,也能预测下游行为.

blocks.en: The geometric view of representation learning is motivated by the manifold hypothesis, under which high-dimensional observations can concentrate near a lower-dimensional structure [ 32 , 12 ] . Studies of neural representations similarly find that learned features can occupy low-dimensional structures within much larger ambient spaces [ 3 , 14 , 37 ] , and recent work has examined how computations inside transformers can modify manifold structure across layers [ 17 ] . These results motivate intrinsic and spectral measurements as tools for studying how representation structure changes throughout a network. This includes complementary local and global measurements that aid in the analysis of latent representations. Respectively, at the local scale, metrics are more granular in capturing neighborhood structure, while at the global scale, metrics are more coarse and use the full embedding space. These approaches have been used extensively in data mining [ 8 ] with clear applications for distributional analysis and outlier detection of latent representations.
blocks.zh: 表达式学习的几何视角是由多维假说激发的,在这种假说下,高维观测可以集中到一个下维结构上[32,12]. 对神经表达法的研究同样发现,学到的特征可以在更大的环境空间中占据低维结构[3,14,37],最近的工作也研究了变压器内部的计算如何改变跨层的多重结构[17]. 这些结果促使进行内在和光谱测量,作为研究整个网络的代表结构如何变化的工具。 这包括有助于分析潜在表现的地方和全球补充测量。 在地方尺度上,衡量标准在捕捉邻里结构时更具有颗粒性,而在全球尺度上,衡量标准更粗糙,并使用完整的嵌入空间. 这些方法已广泛用于数据挖掘[8],并明确用于分布分析和对潜在表示的外部探测。

blocks.en: For example, global rank-based methods summarize global spectral structure and have been proposed as label-free indicators associated with downstream performance [ 13 ] . In S3Ms, global rank measures have been found to correlate with downstream performance, although they do not reliably identify the best-performing layer for a given task [ 1 , 50 ] . At the local scale, LID provides a complementary view by estimating the effective dimensionality of the neighborhood around a query point (e.g., embedding corresponding to an image frame) in relation to nearest-neighbor distances; thus, measuring the rate at which the mass of such neighborhood grows with distance [ 2 , 7 , 26 ] . LID has been used to characterize adversarial examples, noisy-label memorization, and contextual-language-model training dynamics [ 29 , 30 , 41 ] . Related local density statistics have been used to identify backdoor-poisoned samples [ 19 ] , while GRIDS-LID uses layerwise LID features for anomaly detection in S3Ms [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 例如,基于全球排名的方法总结了全球光谱结构,并被提议作为与下游性能相关的无标签指标[13]. 在S3Ms中,发现全球排名措施与下游业绩有关,尽管它们无法可靠地确定某项任务的最佳业绩层次[1、50]。 在当地尺度上,LID通过估计一个查询点周围的邻里(如与图像框架相对应的嵌入)相对于最近的邻里距离的有效维度,提供了一种互补的视角;因此,可以测量这种邻里的质量随距离而增长的速度[2,7,26]. LID被用来描述对抗性的例子、吵闹的标签记忆和背景语言模式的培训动态[29、30、41]。 相关局部密度统计被用于识别后门孔隙样本[19],而GRIDS-LID则使用层层LID特性在S3Ms[4]中进行异常检测.

blocks.en: In the context of recent applications, LID is motivated as an evaluation metric of local structure of latent representations; however, it does not imply that a high or low LID value is a universal indicator of better downstream performance. GRIDS-LID [ 4 ] builds on this distinction by using LID as a layerwise local geometric diagnostic while contrasting it with global dimensionality and similarity-based approaches. A key distinction is that intrinsic dimensionality is not equivalent to representation quality. LID describes local geometric complexity, while effective rank describes global spectral utilization, and the relationship between either quantity and downstream performance remains empirical. Therefore, LayerScope evaluates these measurements against classification, clustering, and retrieval behavior across architectures and network-depth rather than assuming that a particular geometric measurement is universal indicator of performance.
blocks.zh: 在最近的应用中,LID是作为潜在表示的当地结构的评价指标;然而,这并不意味着高或低LID值是下游业绩较好的普遍指标。 GRIDS-LID [4] 利用LID作为分层局部几何诊断,同时将其与全球维度和基于相似性的方法作对比,以此区别为基础。 一个关键的区别是内在的维度不等同于代表的质量. LID描述了局部几何复杂性,而有效的排名则描述了全球光谱利用率,数量和下游性能之间的关系仍然是实证的. 因此,LearsScope对照跨架构和网络深度的分类,集群和检索行为来评价这些测量,而不是假设特定的几何测量是通用的性能指标.

blocks.en: Intermediate representations can retain task-relevant information that is weakened or specialized in the final layers, making network-depth an important downstream evaluation. This pattern has been observed in vision encoders [ 10 ] and in layerwise studies of self-supervised speech models [ 35 , 36 ] . Representation-similarity metrics such as centered kernel alignment (CKA) quantify similarity between representations spaces across layers in a model [ 23 ] . Recent work has also studied intermediate language model representations across text and vision tasks [ 43 ] , selected task-discriminative subspaces with spectral criteria [ 9 ] , and combined intermediate video-MLLM states with a calibrated retrieval head [ 47 ] . Our study instead examines a set of label-free geometric diagnostics across classification, clustering, and complete text-video layer configurations. This allows to distinguish association with downstream performance, layer selection, and cross-modal correspondence, rather than treating these as a single aspect of layerwise representation analysis.
blocks.zh: 中级代表机构可以保留与任务有关的信息,这些信息在最后一级被削弱或专门化,使网络深入成为重要的下游评价。 在视觉编码器[10]和自控语音模型的分层研究[35,36]中都观察到了这种模式. 代表性-相似性衡量标准,如中心内核对齐(CKA)在模型中量化各层代表空间之间的相似性[23]. 最近的工作还研究了跨文本和视觉任务的中间语言模型表达[43],带有光谱标准的选定任务区别子空间[9],以及带有校准检索头的中间视频-MLLM状态组合[47]. 相反,我们的研究审查了一组无标签几何诊断, 跨越分类、集群和完整的文本视频层的配置。 这使得可以区分与下游性能、层层选择和跨模式通信的联系,而不是将这些联系作为分层表示分析的一个单一方面。

blocks.en:
Multimodal models are often trained so that semantically related inputs from different modalities can be matched in a shared representation space, yet successful matching does not imply that different modalities will have identical distributions.
Prior work on contrastive multimodal learning has shown the presence of modality gaps both under random and pretrained weight initialization [ 28 ] . Other work has also shown that reducing this gap can improve retrieval in some settings [ 52 ] , harm performance when modality-specific information is removed [ 21 ] , or impact robustness and semantics at different levels when comparing group-level retrieval versus instance-level retrieval [ 11 , 15 ] .
Together, these results motivate treating distributional proximity - rather than a strict distributional identity - as the key representational property underlying semantic matching in retrieval. As such, LayerScope aims to study this relationship between proximity and performance across transformer layers in a model. Analyses of intermediate vision-language representations also suggest that cross-modal integration develops progressively across layers [ 20 , 44 ] , while large-scale benchmarks such as MVEB [ 5 ] show that retrieval behavior varies substantially across multimodal model families and modality combinations.
blocks.zh:
多式联运模式经常得到培训,以便不同模式的精密相关投入能够在共享的表示空间中匹配,但成功的匹配并不意味着不同模式的分布相同。
以往关于对比性多式联运学习的研究表明,在随机和预先训练的权重初始化[28]中,模式差距的存在。 其他工作还表明,缩小这一差距可以改进某些环境下的检索[52],在删除特定模式信息时损害性能[21],或者在比较群体级检索与实例级检索[11,15]时影响不同级别的稳健性和语义.
这些结果加在一起促使人们将分布近距离(而不是严格的分布特征)视为检索中语义匹配的关键代表属性。 因此,LearsScope旨在研究模型中跨变压器层的近距离和性能之间的关系. 对中间视觉语言表述的分析还表明,跨模式融合在各层[20,44]之间逐步发展,而MVEB[5]等大规模基准表明,跨模式家庭和模式组合的检索行为大不相同。

blocks.en: In our work, we therefore make a clear distinction regarding distributional proximity : the closeness of the overall text and video representation distributions; cross-modal correspondence : whether the correct text and video examples are associated with one another; and semantic alignment : whether corresponding inputs expressing the same underlying semantic content can be correctly matched. LayerScope , also aims to study retrieval behavior through sliced Wasserstein distance [ 34 ] and Procrustes error [ 42 ] [ 16 ] . These metrics serve as measures of representation alignment; the first evaluating marginal text-video distributional proximity, while the second determining paired cross-modal correspondence.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们在工作中明确区分分布接近: 整个文本和视频表达式的亲近性; 跨模式的通信:正确文本和视频实例是否相互关联; 语义对齐:表达相同基本语义内容的相应输入能否正确匹配. LayerScope),也旨在通过切片瓦瑟斯坦距离[34]和普罗克鲁斯特错误[42][16]研究检索行为. 这些衡量标准是衡量表示一致性的尺度;第一种是评价边际文本-视频分布相近性,第二种是确定成对的跨模式函证。

blocks.en: We evaluate the hidden representations of seven video and multimodal models on classification, clustering, and T2VR. For each model and dataset, we extract the layerwise representations once, compute geometric measurements from the resulting cache, and evaluate the same representations on the corresponding downstream task. We compare geometry with performance across depth and use regret to quantify the cost of choosing a layer from geometry alone.

blocks.en: 4.1 Layerwise geometry differs across models
blocks.zh: 4.1 不同模型的图层几何不同

blocks.en:
The models follow different geometric profiles across depth. Figure 2 shows GRIDS-LID ( k = 100 k=100 ),
RankMe, and standardized covariance effective rank on UCF101. V-JEPA 2 has a broad mid-layer GRIDS-LID peak followed by a sharp decline, while RankMe rises near the end. X-CLIP shows a similar separation: GRIDS-LID peaks early, whereas RankMe peaks later. Both PE-AV models show increasing GRIDS-LID over their four video layers. Gemma 4 changes abruptly near the middle of the network, while Qwen3-VL and LCO show a late increase in RankMe as GRIDS-LID falls or remains non-monotonic.

X-CLIP is also trained for cross-modal joint embedding, but follows a different trajectory for GRIDS-LID and RankMe. These are descriptive patterns rather than model-family effects as the models differ in architecture, data, scale, preprocessing, and output processing.
blocks.zh: 相关模型家族中出现了一些相似之处:PE-AV Small and Ligh有相似的GRIDS-LID剖面图,而Qune3-VL和LCO都显示RankMe生长较晚. X-CLIP也接受了跨模式联合嵌入的培训,但GRIDS-LID和RankMe的轨迹不同. 这些是描述性模式,而不是模型家庭效应,因为模型在结构、数据、规模、预处理和产出处理方面各不相同。

blocks.en: 4.2 No geometric measure identifies the best layer across all tasks
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 没有几何测量确定所有任务的最佳层

blocks.en: No geometric measure provides a consistently reliable layer choice across all the evaluated model–task comparisons. Across the 21 Breakfast and UCF101 classification and clustering comparisons, choosing the layer with minimum GRIDS-LID gives a mean regret of 4.47%, while choosing the layer with maximum GRIDS-LID gives 9.97%. RankMe gives the lowest mean regret, 1.43%, followed by the final-layer baseline at 2.49% and standardized covariance effective rank at 3.99%.
blocks.zh: 没有几何测量在所有评估模型-任务比较中提供一个一致可靠的层选择。 在21种早餐和UCF101分类和集群比较中,选择最低GRIDS-LID的层,平均遗憾率为4.47%,而选择最高GRIDS-LID的层则给出9.97%。 军衔 最低的遗憾是1.43%,其次是2.49%的终层基线和3.99%的标准化共变有效等级。

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows how these averages break down by task and model. GRIDS-LID varies in as a layer-selector on Breakfast and UCF101, with the favorable GRIDS-LID extremum changing across dataset and task. In several cases choosing the wrong extremum leads to large regret, specifically for V-JEPA 2 and X-CLIP on UCF101. The main pattern in GRID-LID’s performance as a layer-selector is that it is dataset and task dependent, while RankMe is more stable across the same comparisons. Looking at the correlation between GRIDS-LID values for each model and task ( Figure 10 ), we see positive correlations for some model–task pairs and negative correlations for others. For the LCO model, the Spearman correlation between GRIDS-LID and performance is + 0.942 +0.942 on Breakfast, − 0.375 -0.375 on UCF101 classification, and − 0.656 -0.656 on UCF101 clustering. GRIDS-LID-performance correlations range from − 0.935 -0.935 to + 0.962 +0.962 across model-task pairs. Across models and tasks, higher LID is not consistently associated with either better or worse downstream performance.
blocks.zh: 图3显示这些平均数如何按任务和模式分列。 GRIDS-LID在早餐和UCF101上的层选择器不同,最受欢迎的GRIDS-LID extremum在数据集和任务之间变化。 在一些案件中,选择错误的极端会导致很大的遗憾,特别是针对UCF101上的V-JEPA 2和X-CLIP。 GRID-LID作为层选择器的性能中的主要规律是它依赖于数据集和任务,而RankMe则在相同的比较中比较稳定. 研究每个模型和任务的GRIDS-LID值之间的关联性(图10),我们看到一些模型-任务对正关联性,而另一些模型-任务负关联性. 对于LCO模型,GRIDS-LID与性能的Spearman关联是:早餐时+0.942+0.942,UCF101分类时−0.375-0.375,UCF101集群时−0.656-0.656. GRIDS-LID-性能关联范围从− 0.935-0.935到+ 0.962+0.962 跨模型任务对. 在整个模式和任务中,更高水平的LID与下游的绩效没有一贯的联系。

blocks.en: This task dependence is consistent with LID measuring local neighborhood complexity rather than task-specific properties. High LID may reflect useful fine-grained structure, but it may also arise from nuisance variation, mixed neighborhoods, or anomalies. Lower LID may similarly reflect useful abstraction or denoising, but can also arise from representation collapse. Therefore, neither higher nor lower LID is consistently associated with better downstream performance for the task in our study. Nevertheless, local dimensionality remains informative when neighborhood complexity or irregularity is itself the object of analysis, as in adversarial, backdoor, and anomaly-detection settings discussed in Section 2 .
blocks.zh: 这种任务依赖性符合LID测量本地街区复杂程度,而不是任务特定属性. 高液晶可能反映有用的精细结构,但也可能产生于扰动变化、杂居或异常。 较低的LID可能同样反映有用的抽象或去名,但也可能产生于代表性的崩溃. 因此,无论是更高还是更低的LID,都与我们研究中任务的下游业绩较好有关。 然而,当邻里复杂或不规则本身是分析对象时,如第2节讨论的对抗、后门和异常-检测环境时,当地的维度仍然很丰富。

blocks.en: We hypothesize RankMe performs better here because it measures global structure, which is more closely related to linear classification and distance-based clustering than a local neighborhood measure such as LID. This is visible in models such as V-JEPA 2 and X-CLIP, for which increases in RankMe values generally align closely with downstream improvement, unlike layerwise trajectories in GRIDS-LID. However, even in this case, RankMe does not necessarily provide a consistent best-performing layer of choice. This is shown in the regret scores out of 21 comparison: lower in 8, the same in 9, and higher in only 4.
blocks.zh: 我们假设RankMe的大小在这里表现得更好,因为它衡量全球结构,它与线性分类和基于距离的集群关系更紧密,而不是像LID这样的局部邻里测量. 这在V-JEPA 2和X-CLIP等模型中可见,对于这些模型,RankMe值的增加一般与下游的改进紧密配合,不同于GRIDS-LID中的层层轨迹. 然而,即使在这种情况下,RankMe也不一定能提供一贯的最佳选择层次. 21项比较中的遗憾分数就表明了这一点:8项中的遗憾分数较低,9项中的遗憾分数较低,4项中的遗憾分数较高。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Layer-choice regret by task and model. Each cell shows the regret from selecting a layer using a geometric measure. Lower values are better. The figure makes clear that the usefulness of a geometric measure depends on the task and model; no single measure is consistently reliable across all the evaluated model–task comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图3:按任务和模式分列的层选择遗憾。 每个单元格都显示使用几何测量方法选择一层的遗憾。 较低的数值更好。 这一数字表明,几何计量的有用性取决于任务和模型;在所有评估的模型-任务比较中,没有一个单一的计量是一贯可靠的。

blocks.en: 4.3 Intermediate layers often improve single-modality downstream performance
blocks.zh: 4.3 中间层往往改善下游的单一模式性能

blocks.en: Because the geometric measures in Section 4.2 do not provide a universal measure for best layer selection, we next evaluate all hidden state embeddings at every model layer directly. Evaluating every layer changes the preferred representation in most of the models we study. Across Breakfast classification, HMDB51 classification, and UCF101 classification and clustering, six of seven models have an intermediate layer that perform better than the final layer for at least one task. The largest gain occurs for Gemma 4 on UCF101 clustering, where layer 13 improves V-measure by Δ = + 0.1683 \Delta=+0.1683 for UCF101 cluster and Δ = + 0.0820 \Delta=+0.0820 in HMDB51 classification over the last layer. PE-AV Large also improves at its first video layer on both UCF101 tasks by Δ = + 0.0315 \Delta=+0.0315 in classification accuracy and Δ = + 0.0268 \Delta=+0.0268 in V-measure. PE-AV Small improves performance over the last layer with a Δ = + 0.0297 \Delta=+0.0297 in the HMDB51 classification task. See Section Section D.2 for more details.
blocks.zh: 由于第4.2节中的几何度量并不能为最佳层选择提供通用度量,我们接下来直接评价每个模型层的所有隐藏状态嵌入. 评估每一层都会改变我们研究的大多数模型中偏好的代表性。 通过早餐分类,HMDB51分类,以及UCF101分类和集群,7个模型中有6个具有一个中间层,至少一个任务比最终层性能更好. 最大的增益发生在UCF101集群上的Gemma 4,其中第13层改进了V-度量 = + 0.1683\Delta = 0.1683 对于UCF101集群,在上层HMDB51分类中的Gemma 4 = + 0.0820\Delta = 0.0820. PE-AV Lige在UCF101两项任务的首个视频层也改进了,在分类精度上使用XQ = + 0.0315\Delta+0.0315,在V度量衡上使用XX+ 0.0268\Delta+0.0268. PE-AV 软件 在HMDB51分类任务中,小改进了上层的性能,其分级为: = + 0.0297\Delta=+0.0297. 详见D.2节。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that these gains on task performance do not follow one depth pattern. V-JEPA 2 [ 6 ] and X-CLIP continue to improve task performance after GRIDS-LID has reached its maximum and begun to fall. The PE-AV models show a different pattern, where their best UCF101 performance occurs at the first video layer while GRIDS-LID increases with depth. Qwen3-VL performs best at its final layer, while LCO peaks only slightly earlier, at layers 34 and 35. Gemma 4 reaches its best UCF101 scores before the sharp increase in GRIDS-LID at the middle of the network.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,任务业绩方面的这些进展没有遵循一个深度模式。 V-JEPA 2 [6]和X-CLIP在GRIDS-LID达到极限并开始下降后,继续改进任务性能. PE-AV模型显示出不同的模式,它们的最佳UCF101性能发生在第一视频层,而GRIDS-LID则随着深度的增加而增加. Qune3-VL在它的末层表现最好,而LCO只稍早一点,在第34层和第35层. Gemma 4在网络中间GRIDS-LID的急剧增加之前,达到了其最好的UCF101分数.

blocks.en: Figure 4: UCF101 raw-block profiles for seven models. GRIDS-LID and classification and clustering means are plotted over physical blocks 1 through L against normalized layer depth; task bands show one standard deviation. Diamonds in each shaded right margin mark the model-default output. Task scores share a 0–1 scale.
blocks.zh: 图4:7种型号的UCF101原始块剖面图. GRIDS-LID和分类及集群手段在1至L的物理区块上相对于正常的层深进行绘图;任务段显示一个标准偏差. 每个阴影右边的钻石标记模型默认输出。 任务分数共享0–1级.

blocks.en:
These varying patterns across models opposes the idea of a universal intermediate-layer optimum or a universal GRIDS-LID direction. A layer’s task performance can improve as GRIDS-LID rises, falls, or remains nearly the same. The best layer depth for task depends on what the model is trained to produce. Gemma’s decoder layers support generation, while PE-AV is trained using scaled contrastive learning to align video, audio, and text. Neither objective directly optimizes a mean-pooled video representation for linear classification or clustering. Therefore, the best representation for the tasks may emerge earlier in the network.
Qwen3-VL and LCO, both trained as embedding models, reach their best layerwise performance at or near the end of the network.
blocks.zh:
这些跨模型的不同模式反对通用中间层最佳或通用GRIDS-LID方向的想法. 随着GRIDS-LID的上升、下降或几乎保持不变,层层的任务性能可以得到改善。 任务的最佳层深度取决于该模型所训练的制作方法. Gemma的解码器层支持生成,而PE-AV则使用缩放的对比性学习来对齐视频,音频和文本. 两个目标都直接优化了用于线性分类或集群的中间集合视频表现. 因此,这些任务的最佳代表性可能早于网络出现。
Qune3-VL和LCO都是作为嵌入型号训练的,在网络末端或附近达到其最好的层层性能.

blocks.en:
We find that layer representations and model-default outputs also differ in performance. Across the 21 model-task comparisons, the best layer representations exceeds the model-default output in 100 cases, including nine intermediate layer gains across V-JEPA 2, PE-AV Small, PE-AV Large and Gemma 4. In contrast, the model-default output outperforms every evaluated layer represntation for all three X-CLIP and LCO comparisons.
These results show that downstream performance depends on both network depth and model-default output; the preferred representation varies by modek and task.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,层层表示和模型默认输出在性能上也有所不同. 在21个模型任务比较中,最好的层层表示超过100个模型默认输出,包括V-JEPA 2、PE-AV Small、PE-AV Large和Gemma的9个中间层增益 4个 相比之下,模型-默认输出在X-CLIP和LCO的所有三个比较中都超过了每个被评价的层重排.
这些结果显示,下游的性能既取决于网络深度,也取决于模型-默认输出;首选的表示方式因调制解调器和任务而异.

blocks.en: 4.4 Distributional distance tracks retrieval but does not determine it
blocks.zh: 4.4 分布式距离轨道检索,但不确定

blocks.en: Sliced Wasserstein (SW 2 ) distance provides a useful, but incomplete view of text-video retrieval. Using SW 2 to measure cross-modal distributional distance, we find a strong relationship between SW 2 and retrieval performance across layer pairs. Across 5 models and 2 retrieval benchmarks (TUNA and VATEX), SW 2 is negatively associated with nDCG@10 in 8 of the 10 evaluations, with median Spearman correlations of − 0.6924 -0.6924 on TUNA and − 0.7700 -0.7700 on VATEX. This negative correlation suggests that lower distributional distance is generally associated with higher retrieval performance. However, minimum SW 2 is not the best criterion for selecting best video-text layer for retrieval. Compared to the oracle layer pair, the models’ default outputs incur a mean regret of 0.0097, where as minimum-SW 2 layer pair output have a mean regret 0.2994, as presented in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: Sliced Wasserstein (SW 2) 距离提供了一个有用但不完整的文本视频检索视图. 利用SW 2来测量跨模式的分布距离,我们发现SW 2和跨层对的检索性能之间有着很强的关系. 在10项评价中的8项评价中,SW 2在5项模型和2项检索基准(TUNA和VATEX)中与nDCG@10有负面联系,Spearman的中位关系在TUNA为0.6924-0.6924,在VATEX为0.7700-0.7700。 这种负相关性表明,分布距离较低一般与更高的检索性能有关. 然而,最低SW 2并不是选择最佳视频文本层进行检索的最佳标准. 与甲骨文层对相比,模型的默认输出产生0.0097的中遗憾,如图5所示,作为最小的SW 2 层对输出产生0.2994的中遗憾。

blocks.en: These results suggest that retrieval depends on more than cross modal distributional distance. SW 2 measures the distance between the marginal text and video distributions while ignoring the correspondence between text-video pairs. Reassigning which text is associated with which video leaves SW 2 unchanged while disrupting text-video correspondence needed for retrieval. To isolate this effect, we use paired permutations as a correspondence control. The cross-modal pairs are randomly reassigned while the text and video embeddings are unchanged. Held-out orthogonal Procrustes error and retrieval performance are evaluated to identify if both metrics favor the true pairings over the randomized pairings.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,检索不仅取决于跨模式分配距离。 SW 2测量边际文本和视频发行之间的距离,同时忽略文本-视频对对之间的对应. 重新指定哪个文本与哪个视频留下SW 2没有变化,同时中断检索所需的文本视频通信. 为了隔离这种效果,我们使用配对的布置作为通信控制. 跨模式的对子在文字和视频嵌入不变的情况下随机重新分配. 被搁置的正交 对Procrustes错误和检索性能进行评价,以确定两个度数是否都倾向于真实的配对而不是随机配对.

blocks.en: The correspondence control and orthogonal Procrustes error show that the original text-video pairs contain shared structure. Across the evaluated models, layer depths, and tasks, held-out orthogonal Procrustes error favors the true pairing in 31 of 32 comparisons. Retrieval is a more stringent evaluation because cross-modal structure must translate to correct ranking . The true pairing has higher nDCG@10 than the randomized pairing ( p ≤ 0.05 p\leq 0.05 ) in 27 of the 32 comparisons, with failures concentrated at earlier PE-AV Large and X-CLIP layer depth. Figure 9 shows that at the final evaluated depth, every correspondence-sensitive metric and retrieval score distinguishes the true pairing from all 1,000 permutations. These results show that distributional distance, paired cross-modal structure, and ranked retrieval performance capture complementary characteristics of cross-modal representations ( Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 函式控制和正交Procrustes错误显示原始文本-视频对包含共享结构. 在整个被评价的模型中,层深和任务中,悬浮的正对角蛋白错误有利于32个比较中的31个中的真实对对. 检索是一种更为严格的评价,因为跨模式结构必须转化为正确的排名。 在32个比较中的27个比较中,真配对的nDCG@10比随机配对( 0.05 p\leq 0.05 )要高,故障集中在较早的PE-AV大和X-CLIP层深度. 图9显示,在最后评估深度时,每个对函证敏感的度量衡和检索分数将真实配对与所有1 000个表层区分开来。 这些结果表明,分布距离、对齐的跨模式结构以及排序的检索性能能够捕捉跨模式表示的互补特征(图5)。

blocks.en: 4.5 Cross-modal retrieval peaks late, but the best text and video depths may differ
blocks.zh: 4.5 跨模式检索时间较晚,但最佳文本和视频深度可能不同

blocks.en: Figure 5: Cross-modal distributional alignment and retrieval performance across normalized text and vision depth. The top row shows average Sliced Wasserstein distance (SW 2 ) between text and vision representations, while the bottom rows show text-to-video retrieval performance (nDCG@10) on TUNA and VATEX. Although lower SW 2 often coincides with improved retrieval, we find that cross-modal layer pairs, with minimum SW 2 , do not consistently result in a high retrieval performance.
blocks.zh: 图5:跨规范文本和愿景深度的跨模式分配和检索性能。 上行显示文本和视觉表现之间的平均Sliced Wasserstein距离(SW 2),下行显示TUNA和VATEX上的文本到视频检索性能(nDCG@10). 虽然较低的SW 2经常与改进的检索同时进行,但我们发现,跨模式层对,加上最小的SW 2,并不能始终导致较高的检索性能.

blocks.en: For each model and retrieval task, we define the best layer pair as the raw text–video layer pair with the highest nDCG@10. Unlike modality specific task layer performance as shown in Section 4.3 , the cross-modal retrieval task prefers final and near-final layer pairs. One possible explanation is that retrieval depends more strongly on the model’s final processing steps that turn hidden states into retrieval embeddings, but we do not isolate this mechanism here.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型和检索任务,我们定义最好的层对,作为原始文本-视频层对,与最高的nDCG@10. 与第4.3节所示的模式特定任务层性能不同,跨模式检索任务更倾向于最终和接近最终的层对. 一种可能的解释是,检索更依赖于模型的最后处理步骤,这些步骤将隐藏状态转变为检索嵌入,但我们不在此孤立这种机制.

blocks.en: In most evaluations, the best pair also lies on the matched-depth diagonal. The main exceptions are X-CLIP and LCO. For X-CLIP, using the final text layer and penultimate video layer improves performance over the best matched-depth pair ( Δ = + 0.0685 \Delta=+0.0685 nDCG@10 on TUNA; Δ = + 0.0198 \Delta=+0.0198 on VATEX), while LCO reaches its best VATEX score at text layer 34 and video layer 35 ( Δ = + 0.0062 \Delta=+0.0062 ). These exceptions suggest that the most retrieval performance text and video layers do not always occur at matched depths. Full layer-pair results are reported in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 在大多数评价中,最好的一对也在于对应的深度对角. 主要例外是X-CLIP和LCO. 对于X-CLIP,使用最终的文本层和倒数第二视频层提高了最佳匹配深度对的性能(QQ = + 0.0685\Delta + 0.0685 nDCG@10 on TUNA;QQ = + 0.0198\ 0.0198 on VATEX),而LCO则在文本层34和视频层35(QQ = + 0.0062\Delta 0.0062)达到其最佳的VATEX分数,这些例外表明大多数检索性能文本和视频层并不总是在匹配深度发生. 表4报告全层平面结果。

blocks.en: The SW 2 heatmaps in Figure 5 show that models with similar retrieval performance can have different cross-modal geometries. PE-AV and X-CLIP show low distributional distance between text and video embeddings across a broad range of layer pairs. On the other hand, Qwen3-VL and LCO reach their lowest SW 2 distances at matched text–video layers. Measuring layer-wise SW 2 distance reveals differences in cross-modal organization throughout the model that are not visible from evaluating retrieval performance alone. Because the models vary in architecture, training setup, and output processing, we cannot attribute these patterns solely to their training objectives.
blocks.zh: 图5中的SW 2热映射显示,具有类似检索性能的模型可以有不同的跨模式几何. PE-AV和X-CLIP显示,文本和视频嵌入在广泛的层对之间的分布距离较低. 另一方面,Qune3-VL和LCO在匹配的文本–video层上达到最低的SW 2距离. 单从评价检索性能看,整个模型的跨模式组织存在差异。 由于模型在建筑,培训设置,以及产出处理方面各不相同,我们不能将这些模式完全归因于他们的培训目标.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en:
We introduce LayerScope , a layerwise diagnostic framework for comparing representation geometry, downstream performance, and layer-selection across models and network depth. Layerwise evaluation shows that intermediate layers often improve single modality task performance for classification and clustering, while cross-modal retrieval often performs well at final or near-final text-video layer pairs. At a descriptive level, layerwise geometric trajectories differ substantially across model families and thus provide a label-free approach to characterize representation changes and behavior throughout the network. When using geometric metrics for layer selection, the layer of choice depends on the downstream task and model. In our results of both local and global measurements,
GRIDS-LID exhibits task-dependent relationships with downstream performance, so neither higher nor lower local dimensionality values associate with a best-performing layer for all tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了LearsScope,一个分层的诊断框架来比较表现几何,下游的性能,以及跨模型和网络深度的分层选择. 分层评价显示,中间层往往改善分类和集群的单模式任务性能,而跨模式检索往往在最终或接近最终文本视频层对时表现良好. 在描述层面,各模系的分层几何轨迹差别很大,因此提供了一种无标签的方法来描述整个网络的表示变化和行为。 当使用几何度量衡进行层层选择时,选择层取决于下游的任务和模型. 在地方和全球测量结果中
GRIDS-LID显示了与下游性能的依赖于任务的关系,因此,无论更高还是更低的本地维度值都与所有任务的最佳性能层相关联.

blocks.en:
We have empirically shown that across a subset of MVEB tasks, RankMe has the lowest mean layer-selection regret among the geometric measures tested for classification and clustering comparisons; however, it does not generalize as a universal layer-selector. This shows that association with downstream performance does not necessarily imply reliable layer selection, and that the preferred representation depends on the model and task. Geometry is therefore most useful as a characterization tool to help identify where representations change and provides descriptive numerical measures for these changes, but it does not replace task-specific layer evaluation.
In our retrieval analysis, we have first shown that a lower distribution distance, measured by SW 2 , is associated with higher nDCG@10, but does not generally identify the best text-video layer pair. For 1,000 shuffle pairings, Procrustes error has identified 31 of 32 text-video comparisons across models, datasets, and network depth, revealing paired structure that SW 2 cannot support.
Future work should use controlled comparisons to isolate how design choices such as training objective, architecture, data scale, and output mapping shape these layerwise geometric profiles.

我们的经验显示,在MVEB任务的一个子集中,RankMe在为分类和集群比较而测试的几何测量中,平均层选择的遗憾最少;然而,它并没有被概括为通用层选择器. 这表明与下游性能的关联并不一定意味着可靠的层层选择,首选代表取决于模式和任务. 因此,几何作为定性工具最有用,有助于确定表达方式在哪些方面发生变化,并为这些变化提供描述性的数字计量,但并不能取代特定任务的层评价。
在我们的检索分析中,我们首先表明,由SW 2 测量的更低的分布距离与更高的nDCG@10有关,但一般不识别最好的文本-视频层对. 对于1000个shuffle配对,Procrustes错误确定了32个文本视频比较中的31个跨模型,数据集,网络深度,揭示了SW 2无法支持的配对结构.

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows that the GRIDS-LID errors depend strongly on the task. Maximum GRIDS-LID performs better on several Breakfast comparisons but incurs large regret on UCF101, partcularly for V-JEPA 2 and X-CLIP. Minimum GRIDS-LID shows the opposite pattern in several cases. Neither GRIDS-LID extremum therefore provides a consistent layer-selection rule across the evaluated tasks.
